doc.name: My News Reader
doc.description: What are today's top news stories in each section — World, Business, Tech, Science, Health, Sport, Culture, Politics, Environment, Travel, Food, Good News — from established publishers, in my language, with each publisher's own link and date?

skills.name: Today's top stories
skills.description: Today's top news stories per section, from established publishers, each with its publisher's link and date.
examples: What are today's top news stories?
What is the top world news today?

skills.name: Latest news about a topic
skills.description: The latest stories mentioning a topic, person, place or word, newest first, each linked to its publisher.
examples: What is the latest news about the climate summit?
Any news about electric cars this week?

skills.name: One story and who else covered it
skills.description: One story by its id, with the other publishers that covered the same event.
